content:
We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get 13C NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons count (number of signals in aromatic region ~110-160 ppm). Could also use HSQC to correlate. But simplest: get carbon NMR and count peaks in aromatic region.

We need to call carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
